name: PTSD
description: Pattern related to trauma responses, hypervigilance, or intrusive stress signals.
safetyGuidance: This is not trauma treatment or clinical therapy. If trauma signals interfere with safety, please contact crisis support services.

solutions.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
solutions.purpose: Help redirect attention to present sensory information.
instructions: Focus on the immediate room around you.
Locate 5 objects you can see clearly.
Touch 4 items and notice their physical temperature and texture.
Identify 3 distinct ambient sounds.
Notice 2 scents or tastes.
Take a slow grounding breath.

solutions.title: Controlled Breathing
instructions: Place your hand on your abdomen.
Inhale slowly for 4 seconds feeling your hand rise.
Exhale smoothly for 6 seconds feeling your hand fall.
Keep your focus centered on the hand movement.

solutions.title: Present-Moment Orientation
solutions.purpose: Help the user focus on the current environment and immediate present context.
instructions: Say aloud or mentally: 'Today is [Current Date]. I am in [Location].'
Look at your hands and feel your feet flat on the floor.
Remind yourself: 'Right now, in this exact moment, I am safe here.'

solutions.title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
solutions.purpose: Guide gradual relaxation of muscle groups.
instructions: Start with your hands: tighten fists for 5 seconds, then release for 10.
Shrug shoulders high toward your ears for 5 seconds, then let them drop completely.
Tighten stomach muscles for 5 seconds, then release completely.
Press heels firm into floor for 5 seconds, then relax feet.

solutions.title: Safe-Place Visualization
solutions.purpose: Provide a calm visualization activity centered around a personally comfortable/safe environment.
instructions: Picture a quiet, peaceful place where you feel completely secure.
Notice the colors, lighting, temperature, and gentle sounds of this safe space.
Breathe deeply as you allow your body to relax in this environment.
Know that you can return to this mental sanctuary whenever needed.
